scope.directSourcePixelReview: Eight BOTW sources: sampled contact sheets plus dense native menu/effect transitions reviewed in this task; exact observations and proof hashes in sources.json.
scope.referenceVisualEvidence: Existing complete1fps review retained from production plan; not represented as a fresh whole reference rewatch.

primaryFactSources.confirmed: The gauge describes ambient temperature. Unprotected cold can reduce hearts. Food gives timed cold resistance; suitable equipped clothing provides protection. Stronger cold may require a higher level.

primaryFactSources.kind: developer primary site; indexed Accessibility section retrieved
primaryFactSources.confirmed: Required actions do not need button holds or simultaneous buttons. No timer or penalty for missteps. Item placement can be revised.
primaryFactSources.fetchLimit: Direct page open timed out; primary-domain indexed text was returned and matched retained source facts.

primaryFactSources.confirmed: Uses the Korean effect name 추위 가드.
primaryFactSources.limit: TOTK page is not evidence of BOTW footage or exact BOTW Korean UI. BOTW English Cold Resistance and Warm Doublet were directly read in the selected video; Korean 방한복 remains root-selected glossary spelling without a new Korean-menu capture.

mapping.meaning: Unknown other-person intent; expertise can remove newcomer participation.
mapping.adaptation: Explicit imagined observer/solo beginner scenario under the user-selected BOTW replacement.

mapping.meaning: Serious competition is respectful when mutually wanted; remains generic competition.
Gently lower first-contact barriers in competitive and solo play.
Too much instruction removes freedom and interest.
Protect fragile initial interest and self-directed enjoyment.

omittedNoninstructionalDetails: Reference creator's50-win personal history, named combo, specific arcade couple biography, decision to stop random matches, closing self-deprecating joke.
teachingBackbone.omissionReason: Personal history is not reattributed to our narrator; underlying mismatch and agency lessons remain. No reference footage enters production.

paragraphs.koText: 추위에 대비한 음식을 먹자 보호 효과와 남은 시간이 표시됩니다. 링크가 설원에 들어서면 추위를 조심하라는 안내가 뜨고, 준비한 효과를 확인하며 탐험을 이어갑니다. 처음 하는 사람에게 필요한 것도 문제를 알아차리고, 방법을 하나 써 보고, 달라진 상태를 확인하는 이런 과정입니다. 오늘은 함께 하는 목표를 맞추고, 첫 경험의 부담을 덜고, 스스로 고를 자리를 남기는 순서로 살펴보겠습니다.
paragraphs.enText: Eating food that protects against the cold displays its protective effect and remaining time. As Link enters the snowy area, a warning about the cold appears, and he continues exploring with the prepared effect visible. A newcomer needs this same process of noticing a problem, trying one response, and checking the changed state. We will look at agreeing on the goal, easing the first experience, and leaving room for personal choices, in that order.
paragraphs.claimReview: Actual-game abstract: prepared food, active protection, then warning/exploration, agency thesis and ordered overview.

evidence.observation: Menu gauge, food selection/Eat, effect timer, warning AFTER eating, snowy movement.

paragraphs.realizationConstraint: Opening was corrected during audit to food→effect→later warning and directly re-read in both languages. Preserve this actual source chronology in the edit; do not imply the warning caused the already-completed eating action.

paragraphs.koText: 초보자에게 친절하다는 건 스스로 해 보고, 결과를 알아차리고, 한 번 더 하고 싶어지는 기회를 지키는 일입니다. 그런데 옆에서 보는 숙련자와 처음 조작하는 사람은 같은 화면에서도 다른 것을 보고 있을 수 있습니다.
paragraphs.enText: Being kind to beginners protects their chance to try, recognize the result, and want another attempt. Yet an experienced observer and a first-time player may notice different things on the same screen.
paragraphs.claimReview: Kindness protects attempts and discovery; observer and beginner can have different goals.
paragraphs.realizationConstraint: Independent design interpretation, not measured recorder intent. Carries the first outcome into scene02.

paragraphs.koText: 친구가 젤다의 전설 브레스 오브 더 와일드를 처음 켰고, 여러분은 옆에서 보고 있다고 생각해 보세요. 흔히 야숨이라고 부르는 이 게임에서는 링크를 움직여 넓은 세계를 탐험합니다. 익숙한 사람은 다음 목적지와 필요한 준비물을 떠올립니다. 그런데 친구는 어느 버튼으로 물건을 줍는지, 눈앞의 언덕에는 어떻게 올라가는지부터 알아보는 중입니다.
paragraphs.enText: Imagine your friend starts The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild for the first time while you watch beside them. In this game, you control Link and explore a large world. An experienced player thinks about the next destination and the supplies they need. Their friend is still learning which button picks up an object and how to climb the hill in front of them.
paragraphs.claimReview: Explicitly imagined friend/observer scenario; BOTW is Link's single-player world exploration; pickup and climbing are early actions.

evidence.observation: Playable world movement and mushroom acquisition.
Climbing snowy ruins.

paragraphs.realizationConstraint: The narration says imagine; never identify the independent recorder as a beginner or friend.

paragraphs.koText: 숙련자에게는 다음 목적지에 빨리 도착하는 것이 진척입니다. 친구에게는 눈에 들어온 물건을 직접 줍고, 가 보고 싶은 곳으로 움직이는 것부터가 성과일 수 있습니다. 옆에서 가장 빠른 길을 전부 말해 주면 멀리 진행할 수는 있어도, 친구에게는 자기가 무엇을 알아냈는지 남지 않을 수 있죠.
paragraphs.enText: For the experienced player, reaching the next destination quickly is progress. For their friend, picking up something that caught their eye and moving somewhere they wanted to visit may already be an achievement. Telling them every turn along the fastest route can take them far, while leaving them unsure what they discovered for themselves.
paragraphs.claimReview: Expert route efficiency and beginner discovery are different possible goals.

evidence.observation: Pickup and continued self-directed travel.
Movement through ruins.

paragraphs.realizationConstraint: Inference/example about possible goals, not a measured emotion or proof that this recorder was instructed.

paragraphs.koText: 한 사람은 이미 아는 길을 효율적으로 지나가려 하고, 다른 사람은 재미있어 보여서 처음 만져 보는 것입니다. 같은 화면을 보고 있어도 기대하는 경험은 다릅니다. 더 좋은 장비나 빠른 공략을 알려 주기 전에, 친구가 지금 무엇을 해 보고 싶은지부터 맞춰야 합니다.
paragraphs.enText: One person wants to move efficiently through a familiar route; the other thought the game looked fun and is trying it for the first time. They share a screen but expect different experiences. Before explaining stronger equipment or a faster route, agree on what your friend wants to try now.
paragraphs.claimReview: Agree what the newcomer wants before supplying the full solution.
paragraphs.realizationConstraint: Preserves the source's unknown-opponent-intent lesson via user-authorized solo observer substitution; no claim BOTW has multiplayer competition.

paragraphs.koText: 대전 게임에서 친구가 제대로 겨뤄 보자고 했다면 그 약속대로 승부하면 됩니다. 일부러 져 주는 것을 원하지 않을 수도 있죠. 전력 승부에 대한 예의는 서로 그 승부를 원할 때 성립합니다.
paragraphs.enText: In a competitive game, if your friend asks for a serious match, honor that agreement. They may not want you to let them win. Playing at full strength is respectful when both people want that contest.
paragraphs.claimReview: Full-strength competition is appropriate when both want a serious contest.
paragraphs.realizationConstraint: Must be rendered as an explicitly general competitive-game principle, separated from BOTW gameplay. No BOTW race/fighting labels.

paragraphs.koText: 가볍게 처음 해 보는 자리라면 목표를 작게 맞출 수 있습니다. 야숨을 처음 만져 보는 친구에게는 다음 목적지까지 빨리 가는 것보다, 눈앞의 물건 하나를 직접 주워 보는 것이 먼저일 수 있습니다. 한꺼번에 잘해야 할 것을 늘리는 대신, 지금 직접 해낼 행동 하나를 남겨 둡니다.
paragraphs.enText: For a casual first try, you can agree on a smaller goal. For a friend trying Breath of the Wild, rather than rushing to the next destination, picking up the object in front of them may come first. Instead of increasing everything they must do well at once, leave them one action they can carry out themselves.
paragraphs.claimReview: A casual first BOTW attempt can use one small pickup as its goal.

evidence.observation: Approach mushroom, Take prompt, first Hylian Shroom result.

paragraphs.realizationConstraint: One visible action and result suffice; no invented scoring or success rate.

paragraphs.koText: 줍는 조작을 알려 준 뒤에는 친구가 직접 눌러 보게 합니다. 물건이 손에 들어오고, 화면에서 결과를 확인합니다. 내 조작이 변화와 연결되는 순간이죠. 다음 물건은 스스로 살펴보고 주워 볼 수 있습니다. 이렇게 옆 사람이 만들어 준 작은 성공을 게임의 첫 경험에도 넣을 수 있습니다.
paragraphs.enText: After explaining the pickup control, let your friend press it. They obtain the object and see the result on screen. Their input has produced a visible change. They can examine and pick up the next object themselves. The small success a helpful companion makes possible can also be built into a game’s first experience.
paragraphs.claimReview: Pickup input produces an acquisition result and invites the next self-directed action.

evidence.observation: Native normal-speed pickup and item panel.

paragraphs.realizationConstraint: Show the prompt, action, and actual result; a later Korok dialog must not be substituted for mushroom pickup feedback.

paragraphs.koText: 게임을 켠 사람에게는 아직 알아야 할 것이 많습니다. 어느 버튼이 무엇을 하는지, 화면의 표시가 무슨 뜻인지, 지금 무엇을 하면 되는지까지 한꺼번에 낯섭니다. 첫 접촉부터 재미를 느끼기까지 이 부담을 낮추는 과정이 온보딩입니다.
paragraphs.enText: A new player still has many unknowns. The buttons and screen indicators are unfamiliar, along with what to do right now. Onboarding eases that burden between first contact and a first taste of the fun.
paragraphs.claimReview: Defines onboarding plainly: reducing unfamiliar controls/rules before first enjoyment.
paragraphs.realizationConstraint: Definition plus authored illustration; do not present a new BOTW automated assist feature.

paragraphs.koText: 여럿이 겨루는 게임에서도, 혼자 하는 게임에서도 이 구간은 중요합니다. 조작을 전부 외운 다음에야 재미를 허락하면, 재미를 만나기 전에 떠날 수 있습니다. 우선 하나를 해 볼 수 있게 하고, 그 결과를 보여 준 뒤 다음 행동을 얹어야 합니다.
paragraphs.enText: This matters in competitive and single-player games alike. If fun begins only after every control has been memorized, people may leave before reaching it. Let them try one action first, show its result, then add the next action.
paragraphs.claimReview: Applies to competitive and single-player games; action, visible result, then added step.
paragraphs.realizationConstraint: Matches the reference's explicit competitive/solo first-contact principle.

paragraphs.koText: 야숨의 시작의 대지에서 추운 곳에 대한 안내와 메뉴의 온도계를 보겠습니다. 온도계는 지금 있는 곳의 기온을 알려 주고, 하트는 남은 체력입니다. 추위를 견디지 못하면 체력이 줄어들기 때문에, 눈앞의 길을 가려면 먼저 추위에 대비해야 합니다. 화면의 신호와 해야 할 일을 연결해 주는 거죠. 이제 필요한 것은 다음 목적지를 전부 알려 주는 공략보다, 이 문제를 직접 풀어 볼 방법입니다.
paragraphs.enText: On Breath of the Wild’s Great Plateau, look at the cold-weather warning and the temperature gauge in the menu. The gauge shows the temperature around Link, and hearts show his remaining health. If he cannot withstand the cold, he loses health, so he needs protection before following the snowy path. This connects a signal on screen to an action he needs to take. What the newcomer needs now is a response they can try, rather than a walkthrough that dictates every destination.
paragraphs.claimReview: Great Plateau cold warning, menu thermometer, hearts, and conditional cold-health consequence.

evidence.observation: Thermometer actually visible in inventory; field Pro HUD hides it.
Low-temperature warning appears while protected.

paragraphs.realizationConstraint: Cold damage is a verified game rule, not observed health loss in these clips. Use menu frame for gauge callout and labelled illustration for unprotected loss; never fabricate gameplay HUD or damage rate.

paragraphs.koText: 추위 가드(Cold Resistance)는 몸이 견딜 수 있는 추위의 범위를 늘려 주는 효과입니다. 이 효과가 있는 음식을 먹으면 보호 효과와 남은 시간이 표시됩니다. 음식을 골라 먹고, 효과가 켜진 상태로 설원에 들어가는 과정을 볼 수 있죠. 무엇을 준비했고 지금 어떤 상태인지 확인하면서, 탐험을 이어 가는 겁니다.
paragraphs.enText: Cold Resistance increases how much cold Link can withstand. Eating food with this effect displays the protection and its remaining time. We can see him select and eat the food, then enter the snowy area with the effect active. Checking what he prepared and which effect is active lets him continue exploring.
paragraphs.claimReview: Cold Resistance increases cold tolerance; eat qualifying food, then see active protection and remaining time while exploring.

evidence.observation: Spicy Sauteed Peppers selection, Eat, ingestion, Cold Resistance05:00.
Snow traversal with decreasing timer.

paragraphs.realizationConstraint: The icon is an hourglass followed by05:00, not1:05:00. No mod claim. The narration does not prescribe a numerical duration or claim all food protects.

paragraphs.koText: 옷으로 준비하는 방법도 있습니다. 방한복(Warm Doublet)은 추위를 견디는 데 도움을 주는 옷입니다. 방한복을 입은 링크가 설원을 이동하는 모습을 보세요. 음식은 표시된 시간 동안, 옷은 입고 있는 동안 추위에 대비할 수 있게 해 줍니다. 처음에는 추위라는 문제 하나에 집중해 음식과 옷이라는 방법을 비교할 수 있습니다.
paragraphs.enText: Clothing offers another way to prepare. The Warm Doublet is clothing that helps Link withstand the cold. Watch him travel through the snowy area while wearing it. Food provides protection for the displayed time; clothing helps while it is worn. A newcomer can focus on one problem, the cold, and compare food and clothing as responses.
paragraphs.claimReview: Warm Doublet provides protection while worn; distinguish timed food from clothing.

evidence.observation: Warm Doublet item panel explicitly shows Cold Resistance.
Actual Armor menu, Equip at25.2, model changes25.8, field26.4.
Food timer goes00:03 to absent; doublet stays equipped and three hearts remain while walking in snow.

paragraphs.realizationConstraint: The fast Equip menu is about2.2s: retain1x and explain beside it rather than slowing it. Earlier dressed traversal still has a food buff and alone cannot isolate clothing protection. Do not imply one garment protects every possible cold region; selected Great Plateau context bounds the claim.

paragraphs.koText: 여기서 옆 사람이 알려 줄 것은 화면의 신호를 읽는 법과 해 볼 수 있는 방법입니다. 어떤 준비를 하고, 그다음 어느 쪽으로 가 볼지는 친구가 직접 골라 보게 하는 겁니다. 시도할 수 있을 만큼 정보를 주고, 결과를 확인한 뒤에는 다음 선택을 돌려줍니다.
paragraphs.enText: What the person beside them can explain is how to read the signals and what responses are available. Let your friend choose how to prepare and where to go next. Give enough information to make an attempt, let them see the result, and then return the next choice to them.
paragraphs.claimReview: Explain signals and available responses, then return preparation and route choices.

evidence.observation: Glide, land, run/jump; visible self-controlled exploration.

paragraphs.realizationConstraint: Agency is the design interpretation; no fabricated player thoughts or optimized route measurement.

paragraphs.koText: 이렇게 첫 경험을 돕는 방법에는 조작 자체를 가볍게 만드는 설계도 있습니다. 언패킹은 이삿짐 상자에서 물건을 꺼내 새집에 놓는 게임입니다. 상자에서 물건 하나를 꺼내고, 놓을 자리를 정하고, 그곳에 내려놓습니다. 우리가 이미 아는 정리 행동이 게임에서 할 일과 이어집니다.
paragraphs.enText: Another way to support a first experience is to make the controls themselves lighter. In Unpacking, you take possessions from moving boxes and place them in a new home. Take out one object, choose a place, and put it down. A familiar real-world task connects directly to the game’s actions.
paragraphs.claimReview: Unpacking takes possessions out of boxes and places them in a new home.

evidence.observation: Cursor places kitchen possessions.

paragraphs.realizationConstraint: Retained original source inspection; official publisher trailer game-screen passages only, not claimed raw new capture.

paragraphs.koText: 이 게임은 버튼을 계속 누르고 있거나, 여러 버튼을 동시에 누르는 동작을 요구하지 않습니다. 시간 제한도 없어서 손이 느리다고 서두를 필요가 없습니다. 방금 놓은 물건을 다시 옮겨 보면서, 조작과 배치를 자기 속도로 익힐 수 있습니다.
paragraphs.enText: The game does not require holding buttons or pressing several buttons at once. There is no time limit, so slower hands do not have to hurry. You can move an item again after placing it, learning the controls and arrangement at your own pace.
paragraphs.claimReview: No required button-hold, simultaneous buttons, or time limit; objects can be moved again.

evidence.observation: Visible item relocation and cleared bed.

paragraphs.realizationConstraint: No-hold/no-multi-button/no-timer facts come from the developer's accessibility page; the trailer does not itself prove physical button state or a settings toggle.

paragraphs.koText: 그래도 어디에 무엇을 놓을지는 플레이어가 고릅니다. 조작의 부담을 낮춘 자리에 자기 취향과 판단이 남아 있는 거죠. 설계할 때도 무엇을 덜어 주고, 무엇을 직접 하게 둘지 나눠 볼 수 있습니다. 그런데 옆 사람이 그 자리까지 전부 정해 주면, 이제 다른 문제가 생깁니다.
paragraphs.enText: The player still chooses what goes where. Reducing the control burden leaves room for personal taste and judgment. A designer can likewise separate what to ease from what the player should decide. If the person beside them dictates every placement, another problem appears.
paragraphs.claimReview: Light controls retain placement choice; dictating every location leads to overguidance.

evidence.observation: Actual objects remain where placed.

paragraphs.realizationConstraint: Does not claim all placements satisfy the puzzle; optional Allow items anywhere is not asserted.

paragraphs.koText: 옆에서 다음 버튼, 다음 길, 다음 행동을 계속 지시하면 실수는 줄어들 수 있습니다. 하지만 플레이어가 직접 선택할 순간도 같이 줄어듭니다. 친절하게 시작했어도, 어느새 남이 정한 순서를 수행하는 일이 됩니다.
paragraphs.enText: Constant instructions about the next button, path, and action may reduce mistakes. They also reduce opportunities to choose. A helpful beginning can become carrying out another person’s sequence.
paragraphs.claimReview: Constant instructions reduce opportunities for personal choice.
paragraphs.realizationConstraint: Source's overguidance point; corresponding illustration must keep orders visible while the line describes following orders.

paragraphs.koText: 어 쇼트 하이크에서는 작은 새를 움직여 섬을 걷고, 벽을 오르고, 높은 곳에서 활공합니다. 길을 따라 올라가다가 눈에 들어온 다른 장소로 내려갈 수도 있죠. 지금 보이는 풍경 안에서 어디로 가 볼지 정하고, 직접 움직여 결과를 확인하는 과정이 탐색의 재미입니다.
paragraphs.enText: In A Short Hike, a small bird walks around an island, climbs surfaces, and glides from heights. Following an uphill path can lead to gliding toward a place that catches the eye. Choosing where to go within the visible landscape, then moving and seeing the result, is part of exploration’s pleasure.
paragraphs.claimReview: A Short Hike walking/climbing/gliding supports choosing a visible destination.

evidence.observation: Developer walking B-roll.
Developer climbing B-roll.
Developer gliding B-roll.

paragraphs.realizationConstraint: Retain independently reviewed official press sources; route marks are editorial choices, not game detection or measured attention.

paragraphs.koText: 이런 순간에 옆 사람이 모든 지름길과 목적지를 먼저 말해 버리면, 찾아냈다는 감각을 빼앗습니다. 필요할 때 조작과 규칙을 알려 주되, 다음 행동은 본인이 골라 볼 공간을 남겨 주세요. 도움의 양만큼, 도움에서 손을 떼는 타이밍도 중요합니다.
paragraphs.enText: Announcing every shortcut and destination in advance takes away the feeling of discovery. Explain controls and rules when needed, and leave space for the person to choose the next action. Knowing when to step back matters alongside how much help to provide.
paragraphs.claimReview: Announcing all destinations can remove discovery; step back after needed help.
paragraphs.realizationConstraint: Instruction release belongs here, not prematurely in the prior paragraph; preserves original source order.

paragraphs.koText: 처음 게임을 해 보겠다는 관심을 얻는 것부터 쉽지 않습니다. 어렵게 생긴 그 관심을, 무엇을 해야 할지도 모른 채 끝나는 첫 판이나 끝없는 지시로 꺼뜨릴 필요는 없습니다. 한 번 해 볼 마음이 생긴 순간을 다음 시도로 이어 주면 됩니다.
paragraphs.enText: Getting someone interested enough to try a game is already difficult. That small opening need not end in a first round they never understood or a stream of instructions. Help the first willingness to try become another attempt.
paragraphs.claimReview: Initial interest is hard to obtain; protect it from confusion or endless orders.
paragraphs.realizationConstraint: Retains source conclusion and returns to the same thesis.

paragraphs.koText: 함께 하는 목표를 맞추고, 첫 조작에서는 부담을 나눠 주고, 익숙해지는 동안에는 직접 선택할 여지를 돌려줍니다. 그러면 초보자는 누가 시켜서가 아니라 자기가 알아낸 결과 때문에 다시 손을 뻗게 됩니다.
paragraphs.enText: Agree on a shared goal, ease the first controls, and return decisions as confidence grows. The newcomer can then reach for another try by choice, because of a result they discovered themselves.
paragraphs.claimReview: Shared goal, lighter first controls, then returned choices.
paragraphs.realizationConstraint: Restates the demonstrated sequence; not an empirical guarantee that every newcomer continues.

paragraphs.koText: 게임은 결국 즐기려고 하는 것입니다. 처음 온 사람이 그 재미까지 자기 발로 들어올 수 있게 길을 열어 주세요. 초보자에게 친절한 설계는 다음 한 판을 스스로 고를 수 있게 만드는 설계입니다.
paragraphs.enText: People play games to enjoy themselves. Open a path that lets someone reach that enjoyment under their own power. Kindness to beginners protects their choice to play the next game.
paragraphs.claimReview: Games are for enjoyment and self-chosen further play.
paragraphs.realizationConstraint: KO/EN meanings aligned; no creator attribution, borrowed personal experience, or spoken promotional CTA.
